hints.title: Divisibility Precondition
hints.text: The total length of nums must be divisible by k; otherwise dividing into groups of size k is impossible.

hints.title: Greedy Smallest Start
hints.text: Always start forming a consecutive group from the smallest available number in the frequency count.

hints.title: Decrement Consecutive Counts
hints.text: When starting from x with count c, verify that x + 1, ..., x + k - 1 each have frequency at least c, then decrement.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
K: size of each consecutive group
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying arbitrary group combinations without ordering smallest first causes backtracking failure.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting distinct keys and greedily consuming runs processes each number in linear passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate immediately checks len(nums) % k and applies greedy frequency reduction.
complexity.notes: Identical in logic to LeetCode 846 Hand of Straights.
